application_caveats: Route of administration is a model input. A prediction is route-specific and must not be read as a prediction for another route: IV and SC terminal half-lives do not share an absolute scale, because an SC terminal slope can report absorption rather than elimination (flip-flop kinetics). Transferring across the two is offset by roughly half a log unit - see evaluate_route_flipflop.py and figures/tabs/table33.

Per-route performance is very uneven; see figures/tabs/table34_muriverse_halflife_performance_by_route.csv. The pooled score is carried by IV. Routes with few training rows rank at or below chance and the pooled number does not transfer to them.
status: post-audit models, trained on source-verified intravenous records
